chose: set ignoreDependencyOnFailure:true explicitly on every demo task child's opts, with a comment explaining why
over: leaving it unset and letting BullMQ's default (parent waits forever on a failed child) apply
because: the old kernel set this automatically on every flow child so a failed child was stepped over and counted by the parent rather than wedging the run; --fail exercises exactly that path and there is no kernel left to default it

chose: cast job to the specific payload type (job as Job<DemoPayload>) at each switch-case call site in the demo worker processor
over: typing the whole processor callback's job param narrowly, or leaving functions to accept the untyped Job<any,any,string> the callback naturally has
because: fastify.bullmq.worker's Processor type is generic-any (one processor dispatches on job.name for a whole queue, so it cannot know each job's shape ahead of time); oxlint's no-unsafe-argument flagged passing that any-shaped Job into per-job-typed handlers, and an explicit cast at the dispatch site is the narrowest fix

chose: named the new scripts trigger and sync:trigger
over: keeping run:once/sync:once names, or a name like enqueue:demo that does not generalize
because: the user asked explicitly that script names must not imply in-process execution; trigger matches the new file name (cli/trigger.ts) and the CLI's actual verb (queue.add then exit), and sync:trigger keeps the atproto-sync convenience shortcut the old sync:once had
